symptom: The backend remained unhealthy and the frontend dependency did not start.
evidence: TypeORM migration MakeGoalsCategoryNullable failed with MySQL ER_NO_SUCH_TABLE for Goals and rolled back.

root_cause.summary: The persistent vibe_business database has no Goals table, while the approved first-pass migration assumes the table already exists and only changes category_id nullability.

actions_attempted: Built current backend and frontend images.
Attempted to start the stack and inspected bounded backend logs.
Stopped the failing backend and dependent frontend without deleting containers or volumes.
Applied authorized non-schema UC-14 repair sub-prompts and passed targeted lint plus both production builds.
Rebuilt both repaired images and confirmed the same missing-table fingerprint remains.
commands_rerun: docker compose ps and bounded backend logs
reusable_resolution: Approve and add the proposed idempotent missing-Goals-table initialization migration before retrying the nullable-category migration; do not reset the persistent database volume.
prevention: Schema proposals should verify whether the target table exists in the active Docker database before selecting alter-only migration scope.
